invalid.name: pairs-and-op-type-op-count-together
invalid.why: The two consume-line forms exclude each other: pairs beside op_type and op_count is 400 CONSUME_PAIRS_CONFLICT.

invalid.name: pairs-beside-op-type-alone
invalid.why: op_type beside pairs is refused even without op_count (400 CONSUME_PAIRS_CONFLICT); the service does not pick a winner.

invalid.name: no-consume-line
invalid.why: One of the two forms is required: op_type with op_count, or pairs.

invalid.name: pairs-element-extra-key
invalid.why: Each element of pairs is closed: only op_type and op_count (400 CONSUME_PAIRS_SHAPE).
